about_the_game:
Do you love cats?

  • Would you feel blissful if you ran both a cattery and a cat café?

  • As a cattery owner and café manager, your days are filled with fluffy surprises!

  • In the morning, you care for breeding cats at the cattery; in the afternoon and evening, you

    bring the cats to run the café.

  • Decorate your own cattery and café, and freely cuddle cats of all breeds.

  • Join now to begin your Cat-pitalist journey!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-10400F 2.9 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i9-9900K 3.6 GHz 8 Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: You run both a cattery and a cat café. In the morning, you take care of breeding cats at the cattery, and in the afternoon and evening, you bring the cats to manage the cat café. You can decorate your own cattery and café, and freely interact with cats of different breeds.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
